data.name: Jehiah
data.gender_notes: Jehiah is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jehiah is recorded in name-lists as “God is he”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jehiah expresses “God is he”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jehiah total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: יְהִיָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יְ (Yeh, short for יְהוָה, YHWH) + הִיָה (haya, meaning 'was' or 'is') = God is here

in_greek.name: Ιεωυιας
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιε (Ie, short for Ιησούς, Jesus) + ωυιας (ouias, meaning 'present') = God is present

in_latin.name: Iehia
in_latin.long_meaning: Ie (short for Iesus, Jesus) + hia (from hic, meaning 'here') = God is here
